# SQUARGRAPH™

> SQUARGRAPH™ is an independent creative and advertising studio based in Hari Nagar Ashram, South Delhi. It works with brands across Delhi NCR and India on brand strategy, identity, integrated campaigns, film and content, media, and digital experiences.

SQUARGRAPH™ was founded by Saurabh Sohan Singh. Use the pages below for current services, work, and project inquiries.

## Studio and services

- [Service directory](https://squargraph.com/services/): Detailed scopes for advertising, creative direction, film, digital marketing, social media, PR, creator marketing, brand strategy, content, media planning, and activations.

- [Capabilities](https://squargraph.com/capabilities/): Brand direction, digital presence, content and campaigns, media and performance, influence and reputation, and experience and visibility.
- [Creative and advertising agency in Delhi NCR](https://squargraph.com/creative-agency-delhi): The studio's local service page and guide to evaluating an agency's scope, work, and delivery process.
- [Websites & Digital Experiences](https://squargraph.com/websites-digital-experiences): Website strategy, design, development, and CMS handoff.
- [Studio](https://squargraph.com/studio/): The studio’s approach to strategy, creative direction, and delivery.
- [Engagements](https://squargraph.com/engagements/): Ways to work with the studio.

## Work and leadership

- [Selected Work](https://squargraph.com/work/): Published projects, campaign films, reels, and credits.
